latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Adaptive 12-week training plan generator for Garmin users.

- Generates personalized, structured training plans based on Garmin Connect data (fitness, training load, events).
- Supports six coaching philosophies, each shaping intensity, strength, and mobility in the plan.
- Automatically updates the plan with fresh data on each run.
- Schedules workouts directly to your Garmin calendar and adapts to training status.
- Chooses running targets (pace or heart rate) according to your selected training philosophy.
- Designed to assist with training plans, event preparation, and workout scheduling.
